**In one line**: Anthropic has reportedly brought on a veteran chip designer from Google as it pushes into hardware.

### Key points
- According to Bloomberg, Anthropic hired an executive with a background in chip development at Google.
- The move is described as part of Anthropic's broader push into hardware.
- Building in-house silicon capability is seen as an effort to cut the cost and infrastructure dependence of training and running large AI models.

### Why it matters
The hire fits a wider race among AI firms to secure custom silicon and reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs. Poaching talent from Google — the company behind TPUs — signals Anthropic wants to control not just its models but the chip stack that powers them.
